card.name: Inside the word EXACERBATION in warnings
card.fires_on: The letter piece 'B' in the middle of the capitalized word EXACERBATION, in boxed warnings about acute exacerbation of hepatitis B. A rare second case is a Lao script letter in a motto.

modes.label: Exacerbation in hepatitis B warning
modes.description: The 'B' partway through EXACERBATION(S) in an all-caps warning headline.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Lao script
modes.description: A single Lao letter inside a Lao-language motto.
modes.example: |Motto||ສັນຕິພາບ ເ<<ອ>>ກະລາດ ປ
